Review: TWIST power leg: VHigh overvoltage and overcurrent

✓ 36 PASS✗ 8 FAIL (8 known, 0 new)i 42 INFO
Known failures are the field failures the model is meant to reproduce (findings F-1, F-2, F-3). A new failure is a surprise and needs a look.
Test cases: ✗ D-DIS-01 ✗ D-DIS-02 D-DIS-03 ✗ D-SKT-01 ✗ D-SKT-02 ✗ D-STP-01 ✗ D-STP-02 D-BEN-01 D-BEN-02 D-BEN-03 D-BEN-04 D-BEN-05 D-FIX-01 D-FIX-02 D-FIX-03 D-FIX-04 D-FIX-05 D-FIX-06 D-FIX-07 ✗ D-FIX-08 ✗ D-FIX-09

How to review

  1. Banner. No new failures, and the known ones are the field failures?
  2. Each case: read the purpose and conditions before the plots; check the blue trace against the dashed limits.
  3. Remember the model. Averaged over a switching period: no ripple, no ringing, no device heating. It shows where the energy goes, not what the scope will show.

✗ D-DIS-01 · Boost 8 A into VHigh, supply cable pulled at 2 ms

Power flows from the low side to VHigh under current control. The supply absorbs it while connected; once the cable is pulled, the ~140 uF of VHigh is the only sink.

1 · Test conditions and objectives

ControlPI current loop on iL, reference -8 A (negative: power into VHigh)
Low sidebattery (stiff source, series R_low), 48 V, 0.05 ohm
Supply on VHigh100 V, can sink current, disconnected at 2 ms
Protectionnone (current firmware)
Self-supplyFeeder powered from VHigh (JP5001): PWM runs while VHigh > 8.9 V
Simulated10 ms, step 50 ns, computed in 1.4 s
ObjectiveWhat is checkedLimit
D-DIS-01.aPeak Vds(Q201) stays under the FET rating<= 150 V
D-DIS-01.bPeak |iL| stays under the L201/FET limit<= 40 A
D-DIS-01.cMargin to the 110 V absolute maximum of VHigh
D-DIS-01.dEvents and VHigh at the end of the run
